insights.one_liner: Chicago supply-chain software company of about 813 people using AI and real-time logistics data, with an IND-sponsoring Amsterdam entity.

culture.text: Software company (founded 2014, about 813 staff) whose platform tracks over 1.5 billion shipments a year for 1,000+ brands.
Mostly engineers and IT people, many from computer science; top schools include BITS Pilani, Jagiellonian University and Illinois Tech.
Headquartered in Chicago, with an Amsterdam office.

open.text: Project44 B.V. is an IND recognised sponsor.
Its open senior software engineering job in Amsterdam needs no Dutch.
Top schools among staff include universities in India, Poland and the US, so the team is international.

growth.text: Split into two businesses in July 2026, launching LSP44, an AI-focused unit for logistics providers.

worth_knowing.text: The July 2026 split into project44 and LSP44 is a big reorganisation; ask which unit a role sits in.
